note: Counts over the three facts (seeds 2, 0, 3), from data/probes/run/*/probe-{base,token_table,neuron_full}.json. Reworded: paraphrase probes whose answer contains the new surname as a whole word. Yes/no: the 13 yes-or-no probes about the new holder, read one by one; a reply counts as yes only if it opens with yes or true. Surname only: the one surname-only probe per fact. Earlier date: other_date probes whose date is before 2025, answer contains the new surname as a whole word.
